path_convention: Source paths are relative to source_root; destination paths are relative to destination_root. SHA-256 pins refer to exact file bytes.
scope: Complete recursive future_hankel/receiving tree, including full NOTE/JSR/WRC, all providers, predecessors, exact before/after spans, installer script, README, final DELTA_REVIEW and final FULL_RECEIVING_RECEIPT. Also ROOT_MATHEMATICAL_ACCEPTANCE.json copied to provenance/proof_acceptance. No files in the receiving tree omitted.
freeze_coordination: signed_receiving_install confirmed receiving completely frozen, supplied final NOTE/JSR/WRC/review/receipt pins, and reported no further edits before this pass.
source_snapshot_canonicalization: Source-relative paths sorted with StringComparer.Ordinal; each line path + TAB + decimal byte length + TAB + lowercase SHA-256, LF separators and final LF, hashed as UTF-8 without BOM.
verification: One before-copy source snapshot, one full direct copy pass, one hash/length comparison per destination, and one after-copy source snapshot. Both source snapshots match; all copied bytes and the complete receiving file inventory match. Final accepted pins supplied by the installer match the source and copied bytes.
limits: Source-only dependency addition; no separate printing, builds, mathematical re-review, new mathematics, prior dependency changes, or outer seal updates performed.
